purpose: Initial same-process Rust SBBF14 screen, preserving every original and symmetric public singleton control; exploratory only, no production promotion or global fastest claim.
phase_order: Unmodified frozen Rust harness: prehashed query then hash+query for each repetition; filter order deterministically shuffled per workload. No phase counterbalancing claim.

ranking.fpr_bound: upper endpoint of pointwise two-sided 95% Wilson interval from independent calibration negatives
ranking.native_control_classification: native singleton controls remain native experiments, never external rivals
ranking.quality_deduplication: one original row per family/n/requested_bpk/seed; identical controls and batch repeats add zero calibration samples
ranking.speed_interpretation: descriptive median ratios only; no confidence intervals or held-out evidence

future_confirmation: Choose candidates only after retaining all initial wins/losses; a later fresh-seed protocol must be frozen separately.
